species: Leptin-deficient ob/ob (obese) mice and leptin receptor (LepR)-deficient db/db (diabetes) mice are commonly used models mimicking conditions of obesity and type 2 diabetes.
tissue: Ligand screening revealed that ANGPTL4 (angiopoietin-like protein 4), a stress and fasting-induced factor, was elicited from brown adipose tissue after tenotomy, bound to LepR on PRRX1+ mesenchymal cells at the HO site, thus promotes chondrogenesis and HO development.
cell_type: found that ANGPTL4 (angiopoietin-like protein 4) bound to LepR on mesenchymal cells at the HO site to promote HO development.

sample_source: Immunoblotting for total STAT3 and phosphorylated STAT3 confirmed that ANGPTL4 treatment causes global shifts toward STAT3 phosphorylation state in cultured BMSCs without alterations in p-ERK/ERK or p-AKT/AKT (Fig. 7C).
age: db/db, ob/ob, and C57BL/6 mice (4-wk- or 8-wk-old) were purchased from GemPharmatech (Guangzhou, China).
cell_line: ANGPTL4-GST, Leptin-GST, LepR-Flag, LepR-Flag-N, LepR-Flag-C, or pCMV-empty overexpressed plasmids were constructed and co-transfected into HEK293 cells.
sex: Both male and female mice were utilized and housed in plastic cages under controlled conditions of a temperature of 22 ± 1 °C and a 12-h light/12-h dark cycle.
